name: bir-stekan-su
description: Bir stəkan su — 30 san 3D animasiya qısametrajlı film (Remotion montajı)

scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts BirStekanSu out/bir-stekan-su.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --browser-executable=$(ls -d /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-*/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell | head -1) && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/bir-stekan-su.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/tmp.mp4 && mv out/tmp.mp4 out/bir-stekan-su.mp4
